title: “Where is this coming from?” Uncovering Trustworthiness Ideals in AI-powered Peripartum Information Seeking
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative human-centered design study focused on uncovering user requirements and trustworthiness ideals for AI in a healthcare context. It discusses value pluralism and socio-technical governance but does not evaluate or benchmark specific religious, moral, or ethical frameworks within an AI system itself.
